title: Theme button visible in signed-in header on desktop with accessible name
preconditions: Signed in as a test student; desktop viewport 1440x900; Light theme active; no saved theme choice
steps: Open the home page (/)
Locate the theme button in the signed-in header
Inspect its accessible name (aria-label / accessibility tree)
Repeat on the dashboard, a class workspace, My notes and plans pages
expected: A sun/moon icon button is visible in the header on every page; its accessible name says which theme it switches to (e.g. 'Switch to dark theme' while Light is active)

title: Theme button visible in signed-in header at 390 px
preconditions: Signed in as a test student; viewport 390x844
steps: Open the home page and the dashboard at 390 px width
Look for the theme button in the header (including inside any collapsed/mobile menu if the header collapses)
Check that it is not clipped, overlapped or causing horizontal scroll
expected: Theme button is visible and tappable at 390 px, has the same accessible name, no horizontal page scroll, does not overlap other header controls

title: Theme button visible in public header (landing and sign-in) on desktop and 390 px
preconditions: Signed out; clean browser profile
steps: Open the landing page at 1440 px width; locate the theme button in the header
Open the sign-in page; locate the theme button
Repeat both at 390 px width
Inspect the accessible name on each
expected: Sun/moon theme button visible on landing and sign-in headers at both widths, accessible name 'Switch to dark theme' / 'Switch to light theme' matching the current theme, no overlap or horizontal scroll

title: Accessible name and icon update after switching
preconditions: Signed in; Light theme active
steps: Note the icon and accessible name of the theme button
Click the button
Note the icon and accessible name again
expected: Before: name says switch to dark; after: Dark is applied, icon changes (e.g. moon to sun) and the name now says 'Switch to light theme'

title: Switch Light to Dark immediately without reload
preconditions: Signed in; Light theme active; DevTools/Playwright watching navigation events
steps: On the dashboard, type a few characters into any text field (e.g. search) without submitting
Click the theme button
Check whether a navigation/reload event occurred and whether the typed text is still present
Check the <html> element and page background
expected: Whole page (header, body, panels) turns dark immediately; no page navigation/reload; typed text preserved; icon reflects Dark

title: Switch Dark back to Light immediately
preconditions: Signed in; Dark theme active
steps: On a class workspace page, click the theme button
Observe page and check for reload
expected: Whole app returns to Light immediately with no reload; icon and accessible name switch back

title: Switching on public pages works both ways
preconditions: Signed out; Light active
steps: On the landing page click the theme button
Click it again
Repeat on the sign-in page
expected: Landing and sign-in pages switch Light to Dark and back instantly with no reload; all sections (hero, cards, footer, form) change

title: First visit follows device dark setting
preconditions: Clean browser profile (no localStorage); emulate prefers-color-scheme: dark
steps: Open the landing page
Sign in as test student and open the home page
Inspect the theme button name
expected: Pages render in Dark; button name says 'Switch to light theme'

title: First visit follows device light setting
preconditions: Clean browser profile; emulate prefers-color-scheme: light
steps: Open the landing page and sign-in page
expected: Pages render in Light; button name says 'Switch to dark theme'

title: Choice persists across reload, navigation and new tab
preconditions: Signed in; clean profile; device setting light
steps: Click the theme button to choose Dark
Reload the page
Navigate to dashboard, a class, My notes, plans
Open the app in a new tab of the same browser profile
Close the browser and reopen the app in the same profile
expected: Dark is applied after reload, on every page, in the new tab and after browser restart; a saved value exists in localStorage

title: Saved choice overrides device setting (both directions)
preconditions: Clean profile
steps: Emulate prefers-color-scheme: dark; open app (Dark); click button to choose Light
Reload: verify Light
Clear storage; emulate prefers-color-scheme: light; open app (Light); click button to choose Dark
Reload: verify Dark
Toggle the emulated device setting while the page is open and reload again
expected: After a choice is saved, the app always uses the saved theme regardless of the device setting, including after the device setting changes

title: Choice persists across sign-in and sign-out on same device
preconditions: Signed out; Dark chosen on the landing page
steps: Go to sign-in (Dark expected)
Sign in as test student (Dark expected on home)
Sign out (Dark expected on landing)
expected: Theme stays Dark throughout the sign-in/sign-out flow; no reset to Light

title: No flash of light theme when loading in saved Dark
preconditions: Dark saved; device setting light; network throttled (Slow 4G) and CPU throttled 4x
steps: Record a performance trace / screenshot filmstrip while hard-reloading landing, sign-in, home, dashboard and a class page
Additionally, with Playwright, read getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).backgroundColor and the html class in a DOMContentLoaded listener injected before page scripts
Inspect the first painted frame
expected: Every filmstrip frame including the first paint shows a dark background; html already has the dark class / color-scheme dark at DOMContentLoaded; no light frame appears

title: No flash of dark theme when loading in saved Light on a dark device
preconditions: Light saved; emulate prefers-color-scheme: dark; throttled network/CPU
steps: Hard-reload landing, home and dashboard while recording a filmstrip
Check the first painted frame and the html class at DOMContentLoaded
expected: First paint and all frames are Light; no dark frame appears; no console errors (e.g. CSP blocking the inline theme script)

title: Public pages in Dark: dark backgrounds and AA contrast
preconditions: Signed out; Dark active; desktop and 390 px
steps: Open landing, sign-in and any other public pages (e.g. privacy/terms if present)
Screenshot full page at both widths
Run an automated contrast check (axe-core color-contrast) and spot-check body text with a contrast tool
Look for white or light panels left over
expected: All sections have dark backgrounds; no leftover white blocks; body text contrast at least 4.5:1; buttons, links and inputs readable; axe reports no color-contrast violations

title: Home and dashboard in Dark: dark backgrounds and AA contrast
preconditions: Signed in as test student with at least one test class; Dark active
steps: Open home and dashboard at desktop and 390 px
Screenshot full page
Run axe color-contrast check
Check header, cards, empty states and any bold-palette blocks
expected: Dark backgrounds throughout including header and bold blocks; no white panels; text at least 4.5:1; no contrast violations

title: Class workspace panels in Dark; slide/PDF/handwriting content untouched
preconditions: Signed in; test class with uploaded test slides/PDF, typed notes, a handwritten note page, an AI summary (mocked) and a transcript; Dark active
steps: Open the class workspace
Inspect notes, summary, slides and transcript panels, toolbars and tabs
Run axe color-contrast on the page
Compare slide/PDF/handwriting page rendering with Light
expected: Panel chrome, toolbars, text editor and summary/transcript text are dark with readable text (at least 4.5:1); slide, PDF and handwriting page content looks exactly as authored (same as in Light, ink colours unchanged)

title: My notes, plans and admin pages in Dark
preconditions: Signed in as test student with test notes; separate test admin account for admin page; Dark active
steps: Open My notes, plans and admin pages at desktop and 390 px
Screenshot and run axe color-contrast
Check tables, cards, badges, pricing blocks and form inputs
expected: All pages dark with no leftover white panels; text and controls readable at AA (4.5:1); inputs, placeholders and badges visible

title: Light theme visual regression on all in-scope pages
preconditions: Baseline screenshots captured from preprod (before change) with the same test data; Light active on the build under test
steps: Capture full-page screenshots of landing, sign-in, home, dashboard, class workspace, My notes, plans and admin at desktop and 390 px
Compare with baseline (pixel diff), ignoring the new theme button in headers
expected: No visual differences other than the added theme button; colours, spacing and layout match today's Light look

title: Dialogs and toasts follow theme
preconditions: Signed in; test class
steps: In Dark, open a dialog (e.g. create/join class or delete confirmation)
Trigger a toast (e.g. save notes or upload test slides)
Screenshot both
Switch to Light and repeat
expected: Dialog surface, overlay, text and buttons are dark in Dark and light in Light; toasts match the active theme; text readable

title: Dropdown menus, selects, popovers and tooltips follow theme
preconditions: Signed in; Dark active
steps: Open the user/account dropdown menu in the header
Open any select (e.g. class or plan selector) and view its options list
Open any popover and hover a control with a tooltip
Switch theme while a menu is closed and reopen it in Light
expected: Menus, select lists, popovers and tooltips have dark surfaces and readable text in Dark, light in Light; hover/selected states visible in both

title: Native form controls and scrollbars match theme (color-scheme)
preconditions: Dark active
steps: View pages with scrollable areas, date/file inputs or native checkboxes
Inspect computed color-scheme on <html>
expected: color-scheme is dark in Dark (light in Light); native scrollbars and inputs render dark, no bright native controls

title: Keyboard operation and visible focus ring
preconditions: Signed in and signed out variants; Light active
steps: Press Tab from page start until the theme button is focused (signed-in header and public header)
Check the focus ring is visible, in both Light and Dark
Press Enter; then press Space
Confirm focus remains on the button after each switch
expected: Button is reachable by Tab, shows a clearly visible focus ring in both themes, Enter and Space each toggle the theme, focus stays on the button, page does not scroll on Space

title: Typecheck, unit tests and build pass; dependencies reviewed
preconditions: Branch claude/theme-toggle checked out; dependencies installed
steps: Run bun run typecheck
Run the unit test suite
Run bun run build
Diff package.json against preprod for new dependencies
expected: All three commands exit 0; no new dependencies, or only next-themes / one justified in the build summary
